question: What makes birth in Bharata especially rare and precious?
premises: A crore of Rudras beginning with Mahakala are present in Bharata.
Five hundred sacred rivers beginning with the Ganga are present there.
Because of this, birth in Bharata is difficult to obtain.
inference: Birth in Bharata is rare because it is filled with powerful divine presences and sacred rivers.
plain_english: In Bharata dwell a crore of Rudras beginning with Mahakala and five hundred sacred rivers beginning with the Ganga; therefore birth here is hard to obtain.
